interview.answer: The repair drive is still on, but the notes do not specify the exact time or place.

events.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’m a little worried about the logistics—what time are we starting, and where should people drop things off?
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: we’ll start at 9 a.m. by the community shed, and folks can drop items off there until noon. I’ll put up a clear sign so nobody has to guess.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Pia: That works for me—thank you. I’ll tell people to aim for the shed by 9 and to get their drop-offs in before noon.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Pia: Great, I’ll keep that message consistent and remind people to head to the community shed by 9 and drop things off before noon.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll help keep track of what comes in and what we’re still missing.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps a lot — I’ll keep reminding folks to come by the shed by 9 and drop everything off before noon.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll bring a clear sign to the shed and keep the setup simple. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — that should help a lot. I’ll pass along the shed at 9 a.m. and the noon cutoff so everyone knows where to go.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Eli: Great — that should keep things smooth. I’ll be at the shed by 9 with the sign.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Pia: Great — I’ll keep pointing everyone to the community shed at 9 a.m. and remind them to drop items off before noon.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll keep lining folks up and repeat the full plan once everything’s set.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that’ll help keep it organized. I’ll keep steering people to the shed at 9 and the noon cutoff.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep sending people to the shed by 9 and reminding them about the noon cutoff so nothing gets missed.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye on what comes in and note anything we’re still missing.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Pia: Perfect, thanks — that should help us stay organized. I’ll keep reminding everyone to get to the shed by 9 and drop things off before noon.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Pia: Yes — it’s still on. I’ll keep pointing folks to the shed by 9 and reminding them about the noon cutoff so we stay organized.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm. We’re still meeting by the shed at 9, right?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — the repair drive is still on, and I’m already spreading the word around my street and the next couple blocks. If you want, I can bring back a quick list of who can help.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — a quick list would help a lot. I’ll keep pointing people to the community shed by 9 and the noon cutoff so it stays organized.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll check with folks and bring back a quick list soon. I’ll keep them pointed to the community shed by 9 and the noon cutoff too.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Pia: I’m still steering people to the shed at 9 a.m., with the noon cutoff so nothing gets missed.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll keep pointing folks to the shed at 9 and make sure they know about the noon cutoff.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep doing the same and make sure no one misses the cutoff.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Bo — I’m still steering everyone to the shed by 9 and making sure the noon cutoff stays clear so nothing gets missed.

events.text: Bo: Got it — shed by 9 and noon cutoff clear. I’ll keep people pointed your way.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep an eye on the list and let you know if anything’s still missing.
